#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string dna;
    cin >> dna;
    int result = 0;
    int runLength = 1;
    char previous = dna[0];
    int i = 1;

    while (i < (int)dna.length()) {
        char current = dna[i];
        if (current != previous) {
            previous = current;
            i++;
            continue;
        }

        runLength++;
        bool isLast = (i == (int)dna.length() - 1);
        bool isBoundary = isLast || (!isLast && dna[i + 1] != previous);

        if (isBoundary && runLength % 2 == 0) {
            result++;
            runLength = 1;
        }
        i++;
    }

    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
